title: Commit and push project-specific lighting work to main
objective: Inspect the complete dirty tree, validate the current project-specific flashlight/docs changes, create clean commit slice(s), move the work onto local main, and push to origin/main if it can be done without an unsafe unapproved rewrite. User explicitly authorized commit/check-in and push to main in this session.
instructions: Start by reading .control-tower/memory/l0.md, .control-tower/memory/l1.md, .control-tower/docs/state/current-status.md, docs/tower_operating_preferences.md if present, and the supplied Scribe result.
Inspect git status, branch graph, remotes, tracked diffs, and untracked files before staging anything.

Commit all meaningful current work related to realistic live flashlight controls, the repaired realistic_live_flashlight_2x profile, README/local environment inventory, running examples docs, tests, and durable Tower state needed for provenance.

Do not indiscriminately commit transient Control Tower runtime artifacts, imported session transcripts, packet/run logs, or generated build/runtime outputs unless they are already part of the repository's durable tracked state and clearly belong in the check-in.

If the working tree contains untracked/generated artifacts that should not be committed, leave them untracked or ignore/report them rather than deleting user data. Only remove files if they are clearly disposable artifacts produced by this workflow and removal is necessary for a clean check-in; report any such cleanup.

Run validations before commit or before final success: python -m json.tool examples/flashlight/flashlight_profiles.json >/dev/null; python -m unittest tests.test_orbit_collection_validation; git diff --check. Include results in the ResultPacket.

Target final publication is origin/main. Do not push to upstream. If local main or origin/main requires a non-fast-forward rewrite or force-with-lease, stop and return blocked with exact branch status and the command that would be needed; do not force push without another explicit approval for the rewrite.
If a normal fast-forward/merge/cherry-pick path can put the committed work on main and push to origin/main cleanly, do it.
Report final commit hashes, branch pushed, remote URL role, validation results, and final git status including any intentionally uncommitted artifacts.
constraints: Do not use destructive git reset/checkout operations that discard user work.
No force push unless separately approved after reporting the need.

artifacts: Root README now inventories local active-illumination additions beyond upstream/base SPEAR, including built maps, Unreal paths, commands/workflows, and validation caveats.
`realistic_live_flashlight_2x` is documented as the brighter realistic live profile with doubled intensity (`1600.0`) while preserving the same realistic live settings.

expected_outputs: ResultPacket with commit hashes, pushed ref or blocker details, validation output summary, and final status.
definition_of_done: Meaningful changes are committed on main and pushed to origin/main, or the task is blocked only because a force/rewrite or unresolved artifact-retention decision is required.
